files.roles: Original month and date class roles and metrics declarations

visuals.role: Original Date/Time applet color evidence, not the generic control layout

coverage_limits: Standard native date dropdown and single-selection calendars. Native calendar dimensions and arrow shapes remain; default palette and active date button use the original color and border roles.
Time and checkable date variants, custom parser, multi-select/RTL calendar and witnessed VCL/OCX aliases retain their original application behavior in this stage.
App colors different from defaults are preserved when applied before attachment; an explicit setter during attachment also reclaims ownership, including same RGB.
Physical keyboard and mouse, arbitrary print devices and all calendar locales were not exercised by the native window/message probes.

development.using: x86 and x64 GCC, common-controls v5 and v6, default and PMv2 awareness
adjustments: v5 DTP prints into a borrowed DC and mutates paint properties and the selected clip; save DC and enforce the caller clip as a meta region.

The standalone v6 picker reports its owned child colors in DTM_GETMCCOLOR while the theme can hide those colors in the popup; the same-thread native popup uses shared reversible theme suppression during open.
One transient MinGW runtime resource error (0x5AF) on the x86 launch was retried with lower concurrency; the failed candidate was never published.
